Name: DE-ExpenseType
Statement:
select  eit.Oid as ExpenseTypeId,
        eit.Name as ExpenseType,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        vat.Name as Vat,
        eit.ExternalId,
        eit.VatDeductiblePercentage,
        eit.Value,
        eit.Active,
        eit.CreatedOnUtc,
        eit.ModifiedOnUtc,
        cre.Name as CreatedByName,
        mod.Name as ModifiedByName,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById
from    ExpenseItemType eit
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = eit.Company 
            left join Vat vat on eit.Vat = vat.Oid
            left join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = eit.CreatedBy 
            left join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = eit.ModifiedBy
